newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends lower vs dlr at 1,079.50.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends lower vs dlr at 1,079.50.

text.p: BOGOTA, May 30 Reuter - Colombia's peso closed 2.90 pesos lower against the dollar at 1,079.50 on buying of U.S. currency that traders chalked up to month-end position-squaring by banks.
"There wasn't a lot of dollar supply or demand," one trader said of the lackluster session, adding that banks had only jumped into the market late in the day.
"The market was stable most of the day." he said.
Dealers reported 187 trades for a below-average total of $90 million and said the peso hit an intraday high of 1,076 before dropping to its low at the close.
Colombian banks and financial markets will be closed Monday in observance of a national religious holiday.
